purpose: Contract, liquidity and completed-close audit for the SPY/QQQ core with SOXX risk-budget satellite research. No account holdings or order instructions are used.

SOXL.role: 3x daily semiconductor implementation using a small sleeve weight

BIL.snapshot_status: IBKR snapshot temporarily unavailable after one retry
BIL.role: actual adjusted-price Treasury-bill return from 2013 onward

SGOV_cross_check.role: independent liquidity and short-Treasury implementation cross-check

data_policy: Intraday observations on and after 2026-07-22 are audit-only and excluded from completed-close signals.
Historical strategy calculations use adjusted product prices and completed daily bars.
BIL is used as the actual cash product where history is available; the fixed synthetic three-month Treasury series only fills missing dates.
SOXL and USD daily-reset paths are tested directly rather than approximating them as constant multiples of SOXX.
No IBKR account holdings, trades, balances or orders are used.
